observations: World dirty reconciliation only admits absent Things when required component exists and virtual OfInterest returns true. Physics.OfInterest is tether-nonempty OR planarvelocity-nonzero OR upvelocity-nonzero OR spin-nonzero OR ownrawZ>ThingData.OffsetZ. Stationary initial allocation does not imply a rest callback.
UpdateThing sequence: ApplyFriction; gravity/vertical integration and callbacks; UpdateSpin; UpdateTethers; rest test then OnComeToRest and false return removes system membership.
Gravity applies unless IgnoreGravity, when upvelocity>0 or actual GetZLocation>RestingZ. Subtract componentElapsed*gravity; clamp lower bound to -ThingData.TerminalVelocity.
Positive vertical delta: if abs(actualZ)<delta call OnTakeoff, then ShiftZLocation(delta,true), then OnRising. All subsequent reads see synchronous callback mutation.

Negative delta: capture RestingZ and before actualZ; ShiftZLocation(delta,true); OnFalling; read actualZ again. If actualZ<=capturedRest, capture CURRENT upvelocity after Falling. Bounce requires current BounceMultiplier>.0001, abs(impact)>.0001 and beforeZ>capturedRest. Re-read current owner BounceUpwardForce and force-immunity/grip/cap AFTER Falling, zero upvelocity then ApplyUpwardForce(abs(bounce*impact)+BounceUpwardForce,false,maxFloat). Otherwise zero upvelocity. Virtual OnTouchdown receives impact velocity and current rebound velocity.

RestingZ starts ThingData.OffsetZ; if actual attached parent lifetime is alive adds parent actualGetZLocation plus own attachOffsetZ. ShiftZLocation adds rawZ and clamps upper bound ThingData.MaxZ; Unit then MarkSortScoreChanged.

Thing.OnTouchdown first sets ownrawZ=ThingData.OffsetZ. If attached lifetime invalid and rebound<=0, executes TouchdownGraphic→OnTouchdownFxAnim standalone→TouchdownSound with cap28→rumble intensity/duration. Then conditional DieOnTouchdown Kill, then ScriptManager.OnTouchdown. Common TriggerArgs only; no extra impact/rebound Lua fields observed.

Unit.OnTouchdown tail occurs after base Lua callback: conditional alive,!EditingMode,CanAttack(false) OnTouchdownWeapon request; then all creation-order weapons CancelOnTouchdown ClearFireRequest, planarvelocity retention, squared-magnitude epsilon reset, acceleration zero. Parent owns real weapon continuation.

At final rest test use current post-callback data: tethersempty && planarvelocity==zeroVector && upvelocity==0 && spin==0 && ownrawZ<=currentThingData.OffsetZ. OnComeToRest dispatch precedes membership removal; component allocation survives.
Empty tether vector is an actual UpdateTethers early return. Zero spin leaves angle/state unchanged, including native friction sign branches.
PDB confirms Unit2f6cc5 clears mMoveShift+0x68, not mAcceleration+0x78.
